issues.description: Template placeholder 'url = ""  # CI fills this' found in conanfile.py. Code style rule 5 explicitly lists this pattern as forbidden in merged code, stating it should be filled in by the adapter (应由适配者填写). The url attribute should point to the recipe's repository URL.
issues.fix_suggestion: Set the url attribute to the project's recipe repository URL, e.g. url = "https://cnb.cool/<org>/<repo>/-/tree/main/archives/b/bearssl".

issues.description: manifest.yaml is missing the 'name' field. Code style rule 14 requires name: <package_name> as the first field. The manifest starts with 'version' instead of 'name'.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add 'name: bearssl' as the first field in manifest.yaml.

issues.description: manifest.yaml uses 'build.system: custom' but code style rule 14 expects 'build_system: <value>' with valid values cmake | autotools | makefile | meson. BearSSL uses a Makefile-based build system, so it should be 'makefile' (or at minimum the key should be 'build_system' not 'build.system').
issues.fix_suggestion: Change to 'build_system: makefile' (flat key, standard value). BearSSL's custom Makefile is a variant of the makefile build system.

issues.description: Unused import 'shutil' in conanfile.py. The module is imported but never referenced anywhere in the file. Code style rule 16 requires clean imports with no unused modules.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove 'import shutil' from the imports section.

issues.description: The generate() method hardcodes 'CC = clang', 'LD = clang', 'LDDLL = clang' in the generated conf/Ohos.mk without deriving the compiler from Conan's settings (self.settings.compiler). While clang is the expected compiler for OHOS, the recipe should respect the Conan profile's compiler setting. This is related to R33's principle of not using hardcoded compiler values.
issues.fix_suggestion: Derive the compiler from Conan's settings, e.g. cc = str(self.settings.compiler) if self.settings.compiler else 'clang', or use the compiler executable from the Conan toolchain.

issues.description: The generated conf/Ohos.mk does not set the AR (archiver) variable. notes.md mentions 'AR=llvm-ar' but the conanfile.py's generate() method only sets CC, LD, and LDDLL. The NixOS nixpkgs package for BearSSL explicitly passes AR. Without setting AR, the build may use the default 'ar' which might not be correct for cross-compilation to OHOS arm64.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add 'AR = llvm-ar\n' (or the appropriate archiver from Conan's settings) to the generated conf/Ohos.mk content.

issues.description: Unused import 'os' in test_package/conanfile.py. The module is only referenced in a commented-out line (line 33). While harmless, it violates the clean imports principle.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove 'import os' since the only usage is in a commented-out alternative approach.

issues.description: Empty method bodies: export_sources() and requirements() contain only 'pass'. While technically valid (BearSSL has no external dependencies and no additional sources to export), these methods could be omitted entirely if they serve no purpose.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider removing empty export_sources() and requirements() methods, or add a comment explaining why they are kept (e.g. '# No additional sources to export' and '# BearSSL has no external dependencies').

issues.description: Docstring inaccuracy: The docstring states 'The conf/Ohos.mk is generated in build()' but the conf/Ohos.mk is actually generated in the generate() method, not build(). This documentation mismatch could confuse future maintainers.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update the docstring to say 'The conf/Ohos.mk is generated in generate()' to match the actual implementation.

issues.description: Status discrepancy: manifest.yaml declares 'status: published' (CI upload succeeded) but notes.md states '最终状态: built' (verified, not uploaded). This could indicate stale notes (package published after notes written) or an incorrect status. The review rule requires manifest status to be truthful. Cannot definitively verify without CI logs.
issues.fix_suggestion: Verify CI upload logs to confirm the package was actually published to the artifact repository. If published, update notes.md to reflect 'published' status. If not published, change manifest.yaml status to 'built'.

issues.description: The generate() method unconditionally creates conf/Ohos.mk without checking self.settings.os. If the recipe is built for a non-OHOS platform, it would still use the OHOS config with clang. While this recipe is specifically for OHOS adaptation, adding a platform validation would make the recipe more robust.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider adding a validation check: if self.settings.os != 'OHOS': raise ConanInvalidConfiguration('bearssl/0.6 is only supported for OHOS') in the configure() or generate() method.

issues.description: Date discrepancy: manifest.yaml has 'build_date: 2026-04-24' but notes.md says '编译结束: 2026-08-06 00:12'. The build_date in the manifest is over 3 months earlier than the build end time in the notes. This may indicate the manifest was not updated after a rebuild.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update manifest.yaml build_date to match the latest build date, or clarify which date each field refers to.

summary: AUDIT VERDICT: PASS. BearSSL 0.6 Conan recipe audit completed. All critical checks passed: (1) test_package/test.c genuinely calls BearSSL API functions (br_sha256_init, br_sha256_update, br_sha256_out, br_ssl_client_init_zero) and verifies SHA-256('abc') against the known test vector — not an empty stub. (2) The sha256 in conandata.yml (6705bba1714961b41a728dfc5debbe348d2966c117649392f8c8139efc83ff14) was independently verified against the NixOS nixpkgs package for bearssl-0.6.tar.gz — it is a real hash, not a fake or placeholder. (3) The source URL (https://www.bearssl.org/bearssl-0.6.tar.gz) is the official BearSSL website — confirmed via the bearssl.org homepage. (4) conanfile.py properly handles BearSSL's custom Makefile build system by generating conf/Ohos.mk in generate(), running 'make CONF=Ohos lib' in build(), and copying libbearssl.a and headers in package(). No P0 deceptive behavior (empty stubs, faked status, faked sha256) was found. No P1 recipe correctness blocking issues found. 6 P2 code style warnings include: url placeholder not filled, manifest missing name field, non-standard build_system value, unused import, hardcoded compiler, and missing AR variable. 6 P3 suggestions include: unused import in test_package, empty method bodies, docstring inaccuracy, status discrepancy (manifest says published, notes say built — needs verification), missing platform validation, and date discrepancy. The recipe is fundamentally sound and ready for review with minor style fixes.
